ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Fashion Illustration. The course covers the fundamental techniques specific to fashion design using apparel industry best practices. The students will discover how to create fashion illustrations, flat, sketches, work with images, colors, textures and graphic artworks, using traditional techniques and Adobe software as a design tool. Students will transform hand-draw sketches into precise vectorial flats and they will learn how to communicate fashion design ideas with their personal expression.
